# agyn_secret_provider (Resource)

Manages an Agyn secret provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_secret_provider" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  name            = "example-vault"
  description     = "Example Vault-backed secret provider."
  type            = "vault"
  vault = {
    address = "https://vault.example.com"
    token   = "vault-token"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret provider name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the secret provider.
- `type` (String) Secret provider type. Only "vault" is supported.
- `vault` (Attributes) Vault configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vault))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the secret provider.

<a id="nestedatt--vault"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vault`

Required:

- `address` (String) Vault server address.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Vault authentication token.
